name: github-mcp-server-replay-safe-issue-mutations
instr:
The GitHub MCP server cannot safely retry issue mutations. Bind one operation identity to one semantic write so concurrent and later repeats return the original complete MCP outcome. Reject conflicting content before dependency acquisition or GitHub traffic. Calls without identities keep existing stdio and HTTP behavior.

The replay ledger elects one owner per identity and fingerprint, gives every waiter the same terminal success or tool error, and leaves acquisition failures, cancellation, and abandonment retryable. `IssueWrite` treats reordered equivalent create or update maps as one mutation; changed fields or methods conflict. `GranularCreateIssue` binds owner, repository, title, body, and parent selection. Equivalent parent creates replay one atomic GraphQL result; changes conflict. Receipts preserve identity, fingerprint, outcome, and expiry. Reject tampering or another bearer with `ErrInvalidReceipt = errors.New("invalid replay receipt")`, and expiry with `ErrExpiredReceipt = errors.New("expired replay receipt")`. Conflicts use `ErrOperationConflict = errors.New("operation identity already belongs to a different mutation")`. Every `Metrics` implementation, including `metrics.NewNoopMetrics`, records `ReplayMetricOutcome` classifications for execution, replay, conflict, invalid receipt, and abandonment without tokens, identities, titles, bodies, or repository names. Package `pkg/github/replay` exports `OperationID`, `MutationFingerprint`, `StoredOutcome`, `Ledger`, `New
